caption: The drawing depicts an aerial view of a large, organized garden or park with geometric sections divided by curving and straight paths, rendered in watercolor. The scene is dominated by green tones, with various shades of green representing grass, trees, and cultivated plots. In the center of the composition is a circular garden filled with small patches of pink, red, and white flowers, bordered by symmetrical triangular garden beds that also contain red and white flowers. Surrounding the central flowerbeds, rectangular and square green plots suggest areas for vegetables or other plants. Lines of evenly spaced tall, dark green trees, possibly cypresses or poplars, border several of the paths and mark the edges of the property. In the foreground, there are two small, square houses with grayish roofs and pale walls, each situated on its own plot of land with some shrubs or trees nearby. In the upper part of the image, a large, pale beige-colored hill rises in the background, with scattered bushes at its base and more indistinct green vegetation fading into the distance near the horizon. The overall palette consists primarily of greens with accents of pink, red, white, beige, and gray.
title: A. Elliot Estate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
